brief:
Israeli occupation forces pushed further into central Gaza as explosions struck Beit Lahiya in the north, the Ma'an news agency reported. The military incursion extended the ground operations that have intensified across the territory in recent weeks.

The explosions in Beit Lahiya caused significant damage in the densely populated area. The dual operations signal a widening military campaign across multiple zones of the Gaza Strip.
title: Israeli forces advance deeper into Gaza amid Beit Lahiya explosions
